header.title: Icons
header.description: The system SVG icon set. Color is inherited via currentColor and size accepts xs–8xl tokens, pixels or any CSS length.

intro: Base SVG set (viewBox="0 0 24 24", stroke currentColor). {{count}} icons + aliases (X, Add, Delete, Loader…).

custom.title: Custom size
custom.description: You can also pass pixels (size={32}) or any CSS length (size="2.25rem").

colors.title: Color variants
colors.description: Color is inherited via currentColor. Pick a system variant and the icon group updates together.
